purpose: Optional client-only compatibility inputs. CubicChunks retains storage and world-light responsibilities; the installed render/shader mods retain their own responsibilities and remain unmodified.

celeritas.reason: Requested external terrain-renderer compatibility input; this exact unmodified upstream build is accepted by Demonica's runtime hash guard.
celeritas.binaryProvenance: Third-party upstream auto-build republished on Maven, explicitly pinned by Demonica. Celeritas upstream distributes source rather than official mod binaries.

demonica.reason: Requested external Iris/GLSM/shader compatibility input, alongside its accepted Celeritas build; no renderer/shader implementation is imported into CubicChunks.
